text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English text mentions only \"more than 2,500 items of business\" while French text specifies \"les quelque 2'500 affaires\" (around 2,500 cases) and adds \"que les départements soumettent annuellement\" (submitted annually by the departments), which is more specific than English.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "Each year it handles more than 2,500 items of business that the departments and the Federal Chancellery present to the Federal Council.", "before": ""}, "tgt": {"quote": "La Section des affaires du Conseil fédéral traite les quelque 2'500 affaires que les départements soumettent annuellement au Conseil fédéral.", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.4}, {"reason": "English text describes obligations: \"It plans the Federal Council meetings, draws up the agenda, runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council.\" French text does not mention these obligations; instead it adds a new claim about handling parliamentary interventions.", "type": "omission", "en": {"quote": "It plans the Federal Council meetings, draws up the agenda, runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council.", "before": "It plans the Federal Council meetings,"}, "tgt": null, "severity": 1.0}, {"reason": "French text adds a new claim not present in English: \"Elle traite en outre les quelque 1300 interventions parlementaires auxquelles le Conseil fédéral doit annuellement répondre.\"", "type": "addition", "en": null, "tgt": {"quote": "Elle traite en outre les quelque 1300 interventions parlementaires auxquelles le Conseil fédéral doit annuellement répondre.", "before": "Section du droit"}, "severity": 1.0}]}
